From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace handshake  CloudBridge listing intake

Perfect  thanks Alex. Quick answers inline and a couple asks before the call: 

1) AWS artifacts: For ACE we usually need a completed ACE registration template (attached: ACE-registration-template.docx), a short technical summary (1 pager), and confirmation of any PII/PCI scope. For the marketplace listing we additionally need: product descriptions, billing/pricing SKU, marketing assets (logo/screenshots), and a test account (read-only) we can use to validate the listing. 

2) Ownership: Product should own the technical assets and test account; marketing can own copy/screenshots. If you prefer we can take ownership of the listing upload as part of our services  weve done the upload for several partners to speed time-to-listing.

Estimate: If ACE registration and assets are complete, typical time-to-listing is 35 business days for our team to package and submit, and then AWS review commonly takes 510 business days depending on the workload. So a realistic window is ~23 weeks end-to-end.

Action items before Weds: 
- Alex/Maya: drop the intake form and assets in the Drive folder.
- Product: confirm test account credentials (read-only) or indicate if youd like Redwood to create a sandbox.

Aditya (PDM) and Marissa (PSM)  can you both join the 6/17 handshake at 10:00 AM PT? Ill send a calendar invite with the drive link and the ACE template.

Thanks,
Soojin

Attachment: ACE-registration-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
